title: mixin-dictionary config
description: Config for mixin-dictionary: design tokens → CSS variables, LESS/SCSS variables and mixins. https://prosazhin.dev/docs/mixin-dictionary

source.description: Globs or file paths of design token files (legacy "value" or DTCG "$value"). Default is ["tokens/**/*.json"].

output.description: Folder for the result: <output>/<platform>/index.<platform>. Default is "./styles".

mediaAliases.description: Token categories with breakpoints: <category>.<name>.{min,max} → media query mixin <name>. Default is ["screen", "breakpoint"].

keyframesAliases.description: Token categories with keyframes: <category>.<name>.<frame>.<property> → keyframes <name>. Default is ["keyframes"].

numberUnit.description: Unit for bare numbers (DTCG "number", e.g. Figma FLOAT variables) in dimension categories: "px" (default), "rem" (value / 16) or false (output numbers as is). Zero stays 0.

dimensionAliases.description: Token categories (first path segment) whose bare numbers are dimensions. Breakpoint categories from mediaAliases are always included.

themes.description: Theme token files. Each key except "default" is a theme name: "light", "dark", "high-contrast", …

default.description: Theme whose values go to :root. Default is "light" (base tokens if there are no light files).

additionalProperties.description: Globs or file paths of the theme token files.
